resources.string: Export everything to a ZIP file, or restore from one
The ZIP file contains all your secrets: API keys, your Vertex service account, and OAuth tokens. Keep it private, do not share it, and delete it after you have imported it.
Providers and keys, chats, skills, memory, task runs, and settings.
Not included: wireless-debugging pairing (re-pair after import), the accessibility service setting (turn it back on in Android Settings), the sandbox workspace, and file library attachments.
Save a ZIP file with all your data
Restore everything from a backup ZIP file
Backup saved: %1$d files. %2$d keys could not be decrypted and were left out.
This phone already has chats and providers. Importing will replace them.
Close Mika 2 and open it again to use the restored data. Then re-pair wireless debugging, turn the accessibility service back on in Android Settings, and delete the backup ZIP file.
Export first, before you uninstall anything: only this install can decrypt your data.
